summary: Ben Brownlee was last seen October 3 hiking near Unnamed Peak 13,832 east of Redcloud Peak; reported missing October 4; his body was found October 6 about 75-100 feet below a steep ridge southeast of Cooper Creek Peak.
location: Ridge southeast of Cooper Creek Peak, between Cooper Creek and Silver Creek trails
responding_agency: Hinsdale County Sheriff/SAR, Western State SAR, Colorado Search and Rescue Association (CSAR); private helicopter
notes: SnowBrains text says 'Tuesday, October 5' but corroborating sources give Tuesday, October 6, 2020; row date is the last-seen/incident date Oct 3. Name widely published.
